hook.name: UCards
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for a single ETH/token pool that collects configurable buy and sell fees in ETH via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta, accumulating them in the hook for a designated tax wallet to withdraw. Includes an optional per-swap token cap (as a % of supply) that auto-lifts after a configured block window, with manual override by the tax wallet.
